Confusion overwhelmed The Silent One.

Surely It existed, else It could not be confused, yet what It was and where It was were questions that had no answer. In short, the only certainty seemed to be that The Silent One existed, but had no other attributes. Such an arrangement was... Unpleasant, Uncomfortable, Undesirable.

A change of pace was in order, The Silent One reached into non-existence, and tugged hard at the fabric of reality. Tearing away at the nothingness, The Silent ripped a realm out of non-existence.

The realm consisted of a single point, filled with limitless potential. To enter the realm was to BECOME the realm, to merge with the point that comprised the entirety of the home of The Silent One. Hence, The Silent One would name it The Unity.

Yet a world so far removed from Ebos would be inhospitable to any who lived on the surface. So the Silent would alter it, whoever enters The Unity, and merges with both the realm and The Silent One, would see the realm shaped in the fulfillment of their greatest ambitions. The point would expand into familiar dimensions, and create a world fitted to the desire of the inhabitant. Once a being is sufficiently accommodated to the realm, it may then alter the created world at will, creating possibilities to simulate the expected outcome of certain plans.

Yet a home would be nothing without an egress. The Silent One expended more of his essence, and drew into existence a Strange Card. The Card would serve as an entrance to the Unity, and as a carrier for the will of The Silent One. Any being, as long as it had unfulfilled ambitions and a desire for an audience with The Silent One, would always be able to find the card nearby.

Unitary Only one Bound can exist at one moment in time
